title: scratch.rs and save.rs each read /proc their own way
body:
`scratch::parent` reads `/proc/<pid>/stat` to find a process's parent. `save::shell_cwd` reads `/proc/<pid>/task/*/children` to find a shell's child and then its cwd. The two modules read `/proc` with no shared code, and the test helper `first_child` in `scratch.rs` repeats the children read from `shell_cwd`. Both tests spawn `sh -c`, poll 100 times at 20 ms, then kill and wait.

## Proposal

One `proc` helper, in `scratch.rs` or its own small module, with `parent(pid)`, `children(pid)` and `cwd(pid)`. `shell_cwd` and `descends_from` call it, and the two tests share one spawn-and-poll helper. The test half is also listed under "Tests that repeat each other or their module's own code".
close_reason: Done in 8de4c11. proc.rs holds parent, first_child and cwd. scratch::descends_from and save::shell_cwd call it, and the process tests share proc::tests::under_shell.
